item_name: Rothco Enhanced Molded AA Mini Flashlight Holder
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Enhanced Molded AA Mini Flashlight Holder is constructed from heavy weight 1680 denier ballistic material for durable, long lasting use. With a high density foam center, soft lining and hook and loop closure, your gear is always protected. This molded mini flashlight holder fits on duty belts with up to a 2 ¼” belt loop.
